caption: The drawing shows two views of a textile object, likely a bag or pouch, depicted against a neutral, light beige background. The textile is predominantly red with intricate floral embroidery. The upper view shows one side of the item, with a slightly curved top edge. The embroidery features a central large yellow flower with a black center, surrounded by green leaves and smaller flowers in various colors including pink, blue, and yellow. The lower view shows the object open or from another angle, revealing its pinkish-red interior and a flap. The front of this flap is also embroidered, displaying a central red flower with a green core and green leaves, accompanied by additional smaller blossoms and foliage in yellow, green, and pink tones. The embroidered designs on both parts are set against the same rich red fabric background. Both embroidered panels have slightly irregular, worn edges, emphasizing the texture of the stitched material.
title: Purse
